routes.title: 故宫外：烤鸭或家常菜的一餐
routes.route: 从故宫离场后另留就餐时间，四季民福与长安壹号按预算二选一；不可为排队错过预约，也不是实测步行路线。
routes.note: 编辑分餐与片区安排，非实测步行路线。新增店铺先不计费，选定后逐店勾选；其他自填餐费只填清单外餐食。

en.title: Near the palace: choose one duck meal
en.route: After the palace, choose Siji Minfu or Made in China for your budget; dining queues must not replace a reserved visit.
en.note: Editorial meal and area outline, not a verified walk. Newly imported branches are excluded until selected; manual dining covers meals outside the guide list.

routes.title: 前门：烧麦、炸酱面与烤鸭分餐选
routes.route: 正餐先从三家中选一家；若另加点心则减少正餐份量。不要把三店平台人均都当作同一顿必需消费。
routes.note: 编辑分餐与片区安排，非实测步行路线。新增店铺先不计费，选定后逐店勾选；其他自填餐费只填清单外餐食。

en.title: Qianmen: choose shaomai, noodles or duck
en.route: Choose one main meal from three branches and reduce portions if adding snacks; all three averages are not one mandatory meal.
en.note: Editorial meal and area outline, not a verified walk. Newly imported branches are excluded until selected; manual dining covers meals outside the guide list.

routes.title: 天坛之后：铜锅涮肉
routes.route: 按所走园门和同行体力另行导航到天坛南门店，羊肉、蔬菜、小料按人数点，晚高峰留等位时间。
routes.note: 编辑分餐与片区安排，非实测步行路线。新增店铺先不计费，选定后逐店勾选；其他自填餐费只填清单外餐食。

en.title: After the Temple of Heaven: lamb hotpot
en.route: Navigate separately to the south-gate branch for a shared lamb meal and allow for evening queues.
en.note: Editorial meal and area outline, not a verified walk. Newly imported branches are excluded until selected; manual dining covers meals outside the guide list.

routes.title: 牛街：涮肉正餐

routes.note: 编辑分餐与片区安排，非实测步行路线。新增店铺先不计费，选定后逐店勾选；其他自填餐费只填清单外餐食。

en.title: Niujie: a shared hotpot meal
en.route: Plan Jubaoyuan as one shared meal and distinguish dine-in from takeaway queues; confirm broth, dips and bread.
en.note: Editorial meal and area outline, not a verified walk. Newly imported branches are excluded until selected; manual dining covers meals outside the guide list.

routes.title: 护国寺与鼓楼：早点二选一
routes.route: 两家分属不同位置，不是连续必走路线；按当天胡同行程选一处。豆汁、炒肝等特殊口味先少量尝试。
routes.note: 编辑分餐与片区安排，非实测步行路线。新增店铺先不计费，选定后逐店勾选；其他自填餐费只填清单外餐食。

en.title: Huguosi or Gulou: choose a breakfast stop
en.route: The two stops are in different locations: choose for your hutong day and try distinctive fermented or offal dishes modestly.
en.note: Editorial meal and area outline, not a verified walk. Newly imported branches are excluded until selected; manual dining covers meals outside the guide list.

routes.title: 奥运片区：梨汤配一顿家常菜

routes.note: 编辑分餐与片区安排，非实测步行路线。新增店铺先不计费，选定后逐店勾选；其他自填餐费只填清单外餐食。

en.title: Olympic area: pear soup and home-style dishes

en.note: Editorial meal and area outline, not a verified walk. Newly imported branches are excluded until selected; manual dining covers meals outside the guide list.

routes.title: 朝阳：日坛涮肉或三里屯烤鸭
routes.route: 两处选一顿而非步行连吃；前者共享铜锅，后者高预算烤鸭，分别确认座位、服务费和交通。
routes.note: 编辑分餐与片区安排，非实测步行路线。新增店铺先不计费，选定后逐店勾选；其他自填餐费只填清单外餐食。

en.title: Chaoyang: Ritan hotpot or Sanlitun duck

en.note: Editorial meal and area outline, not a verified walk. Newly imported branches are excluded until selected; manual dining covers meals outside the guide list.

routes.title: 东直门：四合院共享正餐

en.title: Dongzhimen: a courtyard shared meal

en.note: Editorial meal and area outline, not a verified walk. Newly imported branches are excluded until selected; manual dining covers meals outside the guide list.

routes.title: 外滩周边：生煎或面食

routes.note: 编辑分餐与片区安排，非实测步行路线。新增店铺先不计费，选定后逐店勾选；其他自填餐费只填清单外餐食。

en.title: Bund area: buns or noodles

en.note: Editorial meal and area outline, not a verified walk. Newly imported branches are excluded until selected; manual dining covers meals outside the guide list.

routes.title: 豫园：小笼或点心正餐

routes.note: 编辑分餐与片区安排，非实测步行路线。新增店铺先不计费，选定后逐店勾选；其他自填餐费只填清单外餐食。

en.title: Yuyuan: dumplings or a dim-sum meal
en.route: Choose Nanxiang, Lu Bo Lang or Shanghai Lao Fan Dian, distinguishing takeaway dumplings from a shared meal.
en.note: Editorial meal and area outline, not a verified walk. Newly imported branches are excluded until selected; manual dining covers meals outside the guide list.

routes.title: 南京路：糕团小食与高预算餐二选
routes.route: 沈大成适合小食，龙凤厅属于另一个预算层次；按当天预算选择，不默认从小食一路吃到酒店宴席。
routes.note: 编辑分餐与片区安排，非实测步行路线。新增店铺先不计费，选定后逐店勾选；其他自填餐费只填清单外餐食。

en.title: Nanjing Road: rice cakes or hotel dining

en.note: Editorial meal and area outline, not a verified walk. Newly imported branches are excluded until selected; manual dining covers meals outside the guide list.

routes.title: 人民广场周边：排骨年糕的一餐

routes.note: 编辑分餐与片区安排，非实测步行路线。新增店铺先不计费，选定后逐店勾选；其他自填餐费只填清单外餐食。

en.title: People’s Square area: ribs and rice cakes
en.route: Use the current Ninghai East Road address; choose ribs and rice cakes with optional soup or noodles.
en.note: Editorial meal and area outline, not a verified walk. Newly imported branches are excluded until selected; manual dining covers meals outside the guide list.

routes.title: 徐汇：生煎或本帮共享菜
routes.route: 小杨生煎是简餐，人和馆是共享正餐；两处按行程和预算二选一，不承诺两店步行相邻。
routes.note: 编辑分餐与片区安排，非实测步行路线。新增店铺先不计费，选定后逐店勾选；其他自填餐费只填清单外餐食。

en.title: Xuhui: pan-fried buns or a shared Shanghai meal

en.note: Editorial meal and area outline, not a verified walk. Newly imported branches are excluded until selected; manual dining covers meals outside the guide list.

routes.title: 丽园路：现蒸汤包的一餐

routes.note: 编辑分餐与片区安排，非实测步行路线。新增店铺先不计费，选定后逐店勾选；其他自填餐费只填清单外餐食。

en.title: Liyuan Road: freshly steamed soup dumplings

routes.title: 南京西路：点心或素食套餐
routes.route: 王家沙与福和慧价格和位置不同，分别选作点心餐或高预算预约餐，不是连吃路线；素食过敏原仍需确认。

routes.title: 九江路：按季节安排蟹餐
routes.route: 先确认季节菜单、蟹规格与套餐人数，再决定是否安排成隆行；预算不够可改选其他路线，不强行增加蟹宴。
routes.note: 编辑分餐与片区安排，非实测步行路线。新增店铺先不计费，选定后逐店勾选；其他自填餐费只填清单外餐食。
